existing_proofs_preserved: Both source directions, two fp8 formats and fp16/fp32 reverse inputs are materialized with destination casts. The duplicate forward store is preserved. Four public Real contracts prove complete masked copy execution, finite bounds and tagged-cell frame; two full typed address-commutation equivalences preserve every state/failure with no numerical rewrite rule. TypedExecution supplies nonempty abstract exact-Real witnesses, not native conversion or round-trip identities.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: Full typed load and both destination-converting stores; general public value result is precision-erased.
int8 assertion, CUDA check, byte reinterpretation, allocation, storage-size count and complete launch not composed.
Full typed load and destination conversion for fp16/fp32 input and e4/e5 output.
Input dtype check is represented by two input selectors; host reinterpretation/allocation/storage count/grid/return uncomposed.

test_harness_classification: The top-level test_* helper only constructs examples and calls production; production does not call it. It remains in the hashed source inventory and is explicitly classified as a harness for this review.
dtype_review: The wrapper explicitly accepts fp16/fp32 reverse input and requires int8 forward storage; these are retained. Its dtypes argument is unguarded, whereas Format has only e4nv and e5. Other supplied reinterpretation formats or precise rejections are not covered.
branch_review: Forward duplicate stores, reverse single store and tail masks are retained. No invented round-trip identity is assumed. Assertions and host choices remain outside public per-program proofs.

structural_gaps.finding: All four public value contracts erase dtype and conclude the original Real value. TypedExecution proves only a fixed one-active-lane abstract Real witness with identity casts; the two typed public theorems are equivalences. General source conversion values and frame under explicit rounding callbacks are absent.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The omitted source behavior needs an executing correspondence and coverage statement; a scalar numerical binding alone cannot supply it.

def correct_target (kernel : ComputeKernel) (Y X : RegionName) (N B : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ A : FlatAlloc, A.Disjoint → (∀ r, r ∉ A.regions → A.extent r=0) →
  ∀ u : BlockState, u.undef=(fun _ _ => 0) → Bounds Y X N B u A.extent →
    ∃ v, exec (A.flattenKernel kernel.toAlgKernel) (A.flattenState u)=some v ∧
      (∀ j : Fin B, offset u B j<N → v.readMem A.flat (A.addr Y (offset u B j))=u.readMem X (offset u B j)) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside A u Y N B r o → v.mem r o=(A.flattenState u).mem r o)

def f16_to_f8(x: torch.Tensor, dtypes=tl.float8e5) -> torch.Tensor:
    assert x.dtype in [torch.float16, torch.float32]
    assert "cuda" in str(x.device), f"CUDA tensors only but got {x.device}"
    ret = torch.empty_like(x, dtype=torch.int8)
    grid = lambda META: (triton.cdiv(x.numel(), META['BLOCK_SIZE']),)
    numel = x.untyped_storage().size() // x.element_size()
    kernel_f16_to_f8[grid](triton.reinterpret(ret, dtypes), x, numel, BLOCK_SIZE=1024)
    return ret

numerical_boundary: Exact destination conversion callbacks can be registered and deferred once used by a general executing value result. Current abstract witnesses and relative equivalence do not provide that result or the byte reinterpretation relation.
precondition_assessment: Per-program bounds, positive reduction width and injective/nonoverlapping output maps are legitimate selected-domain premises, not defects by themselves. Source-domain exclusions and absent host composition are recorded separately.
